steps.content: CLAAANG!
Under their combined assault, the assassin is forced back again and again. Yet with each retreat, the black-red glow on his dagger intensifies, its sinister aura searing the very air.
Seeing him gather himself for a final, desperate strike, Helga lunges, fingers outstretched for his throat. But she is a heartbeat too slow.
The necrotic energy animates. It peels from the blade not as light, but as a gouging scythe of solidified malice. It flies past Helga's face and hurtles, unerringly, for Hypatia's neck.
Too close. No time to dodge.
In a flash, a blur of white shoves her aside. The lethal sorcery, meant for her throat, sinks deep into her rescuer's arm with a sickening thud.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Um...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Margaret...!

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Tsk, stop there!
Helga reaches for the assassin's cloak, her fingers grasping only air as he twists away. Using the distraction, he hurls himself through the window and is swallowed by the night.
(Scene Brightens)
The flesh around the wound is stained a sickening purple-black by the sorcery's lingering energy. Blood pulses from the grievous injury, refusing to clot.

With frantic precision, Hypatia activates the Aurum Secretum device for emergency treatment. Channeling it at full power, she watches as the ragged edges of the wound finally, slowly, begin to knit together.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I am so terribly sorry... Ms. Margaret... This is all my fault...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: It's nothing. You're unharmed. That's what matters.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: So this is the Underground... the true power hiding behind the Luminaris Society and pushing the Black Ring project.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The Senate thought using their proxy instead of a Fraser assassin would distance them. Charming.
Just as Hypatia finishes securing the final bandage, Helga swings back through the window.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Lost him. His sorcery was like nothing I've seen, burrowing through solid ground. Been in this city for decades and never seen its kind. He's bleeding bad, though. Won't be back soon.
Her gaze instantly locks onto the scene: the two women bent over the fresh dressing.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: So. Assassin's gone, you're cut up, and our trap's sprung. What's the brilliant plan now?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hmm... I had hoped this would give us some leverage against the Senate. A shame.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Now they're back in the shadows, and we're exposed. Not the best time to make another move. Helga, I need you to get Hypa out of the city. Keep her safe.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What...
Hypatia's expression tenses as she abruptly rises to her feet.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No. Absolutely not. You are injured, Ms. Margaret. Ms. Helga should stay with you, more than ever.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... I can leave alone and find somewhere to hide. I've done it before...

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Think it's that simple? You're in the thick of it now, girl. Drop the high-minded act.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: You've no idea the net they've cast. With that sad little disguise of yours, you'd be snatched up before you reached the gate.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: What then? Get dragged back to the Senate so Margaret here has to bleed for you again? Or maybe run headlong into that killer and finish his job for him?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: That's enough, Helga. Don't frighten her.
Margaret takes Hypatia's hand in her own, patting it softly in a gesture of comfort.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: We are comrades and friends. Protecting one another—and getting hurt in the process—is what that means. You need not worry about it, nor blame yourself for it.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I suggested you leave only for your protection. But if you wish to stay, I will respect your choice.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Then we think of another way. The Senate broke their word and sent a killer to my doorstep. I do not take that lightly.
After a moment of pensive silence, Hypatia lifts her head and turns her gaze toward the window.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The answer... lies with that Underground assassin.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The Underground sorcery leaves a unique residue. I can trace it. If he will not return to us, I will go to him.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Finding him could unveil the proof linking Fraser to the Underground. It may expose their agents within our walls, perhaps... even lead us to the mastermind of BR-005.
At the thought of the Undergrounders behind BR-005, a cold fire ignites in her chest.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: There's my clever Hypa. I see the pieces have already fallen into place for you.
Across from her, Margaret snaps her fan shut with a soft click. A knowing smile plays on her lips as she gestures toward Helga, an open invitation in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: In that case, you’ll require instruction from a professional—on how to move unseen. Otherwise, with that sad little disguise of yours, the Senate would have you the moment you step outside. Don’t you agree, Helga?
The tension lasts only a second longer. Then, Hypatia steps forward with resolve and offers Helga a deep, respectful bow.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Helga. I am aware of my... deficiencies. But I wish to be of true help to Ms. Margaret. I would be grateful for your guidance.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Tch. Alright then. Listen close, girl. I'm only saying this once.
